# Agent Entry (GitHub Compatibility)

Primary agent policy source is the repository root file:

- `AGENTS.md`

Skill-based agent definitions live in:

- `.github/skills/`

Machine-readable agent contracts live in:

- `ai-agent/`

Canonical script domains are indexed in:

- `scripts/agents/INDEX.md`

This file exists for tooling compatibility that expects an agent definition under `.github/`.
